title: Elavon (US) — PYC-40001 'transaction status validation pending' HTTP 500 on settlement flows, no fix on our side
symptom: Elavon (US) returns HTTP 500 with PSP error code PYC-40001 ('transaction status validation pending' / 'transaction status validation error') on the initial Authorize/Purchase step of settlement-flow tests (capture, refund, void, and multi-step purchase/authorize -> capture -> refund chains). The test expects the order to reach an authorized/successful state (or, in decline-flow variants, a clean HTTP 422 decline) but Elavon's settlement status validation endpoint responds with 500 instead, blocking every downstream step that depends on it. Confirmed external to DEUNA: Elavon's side, not a code bug.
recipe: NOT a fix — this is a known, recurring Elavon-side (PSP) failure confirmed external to DEUNA: no code change on our side resolves it. Do NOT propose a diff, do not relax assertions, do not escalate to serviceInvestigator.
